exceptional_items_note: Exceptional Items for the quarter and six months ended 30th September, 2026 of t 25.66 crores represent expenses incurred in relation to the acquisition of the pulp and paper business of Aditya Birla Real Estate Limited, operated under the name of 'Century Pulp and Paper'. Exceptional Items for the quarter and six months ended 30th September, 2025 of t 88.08 crores represent final settlement of the insurance claim towards leaf tobacco stocks, which were destroyed due to fire at a third party owned warehouse in an earlier year.
